items.text: In Game 1 of the 1954 World Series at the Polo Grounds, New York Giants center fielder Willie Mays made the play known as The Catch, on a ball hit by Vic Wertz of the Cleveland Indians.
items.question: Who did you follow the 1954 World Series with, and do you remember hearing about Willie Mays and The Catch?
items.source_quote: September 29 – The Catch (baseball): A notable defensive play is made by New York Giants center fielder Willie Mays on a ball hit by Cleveland Indians batter Vic Wertz during Game 1 of the 1954 World Series at the Polo Grounds in Upper Manhattan.

items.text: Texas Instruments announced the development of the first transistor radio on October 18, 1954.
